programmes.d: Never a dull moment in my old stomping grounds, San Diego is one of my favorite cities in America and for good reason, great weather, great food, great military heritage, and awesome fishing.
Our love of Alaska, “America’s Africa” is continued this season joining Mike Briggs as he hosts us at the Clover Pass Resort near Ketchikan, in beautiful Southeast Alaska.
Plenty has been written, photographed, and filmed about the Florida Keys, and the epicenter of fishing activity that surrounds them.
The South Pacific, a place so endearing in terms of the people, the fishing, and the diving, no place in the region can compare to Matava Resort on Kadavu Island.

programmes.t: Fishful Thinking: Lindberghs Reindeer Lake Pike
programmes.d: Destination is Lindbergh' Reindeer Lake Lodge in northern Saskatchewan. If you have ever dreamed of catching Pike until your arms hurt, and some of them true monsters, this is your destination. Learn a few tricks and hang on!

programmes.t: Fishful Thinking: Florida Bass and Flatfish Salmon
programmes.d: This episode starts in Kissimmee Florida, then out in Lake Ontario for early Salmon. Fishing during cold fronts can be challenging, but a few tricks will keep the rods bent and the fish hitting.
Destination is North Lake PEI fishing for Giant Bluefin Tuna on the Lil' Miss Maddy with Capt.Tony MacDonald. The team is up to the challenge... get ready for a true monster hunt!

programmes.t: Fishful Thinking: Slow Death Walleye and Lunkerhunt Goby
programmes.d: An informative episode... first Walleye fishing in the north country. Attention to detail always pay off. Then drop shot rigs for Bass on Lake Erie.
Fishing the St.John area in N.B. for Sturgeon. There are plenty of fish to enjoy but a few tricks, attention to detail and proper boat position can make it even more enjoyable.

programmes.t: Fishful Thinking: Big Fish of the Year
programmes.d: A highlight of some of the largest fish caught this year. This is for the viewers who love to see the monsters!!
Exploring the rugged Paringa River mouth and jet boating the Hall in remote South Westland.
A relaxing morning of whitebaiting with Sid—classic Kiwi tradition meets underwater spectacle.
Fishing soft baits and exploring scenic fishing spots around the Cavalli Islands.
A soft bait masterclass in the Bay of Islands, diving for scallops and a young fisher’s first spear catch.

programmes.t: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
programmes.d: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

programmes.t: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
programmes.d: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programmes.t: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programmes.d: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it!  Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programmes.t: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programmes.d: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.
Andrew Harding and Matt Hince team up to visit a huge man-made lake - one of New Zealand's most famous trophy trout waters - in the country's North Island: Lake Otamangakau.

New Zealand's Southland's four major rivers are famous as brown trout fisheries, especially in the upper and middle sections, but in this episode Anto Hall and Mike Wilkinson are heading to the estuaries, to fish the annual smelt run.

programmes.t: Pure Fly NZ: Golden Bay Kingfish
programmes.d: Discovering new waters to fish is among the pinnacles of the fly fishing experience, and this saltwater flats fishery, Golden Bay, is just such a gem. Kingfish have a unique relationship with short-tailed stingrays, which they use as mobile cover.

This episode of Pure Fly NZ sees a helicopter ride take anglers Cory Scott and Chris Charland deep into the the mountains to target New Zealand's famous trophy trout, but will an approaching weather-bomb cause them a headache.
Lake Taupo was formed in the caldera caused by an enormous volcanic explosion. The Tauranga is one of the few tributaries that the lake's legendary rainbow trout use to spawn.
The South Island's Otago Lakes District is the location for remarkable autumn trout fishing brought about by the fish leaving the lakes and heading upstream to spawn.

programmes.d: Can't decide whether you're a barra or blue water kinda person? Well, put your worries behind you, because this week, we've got it all!

programmes.t: IFISH: Mako Shark, St Helens, TAS
programmes.d: One has a shell and the other big teeth. One swims the open oceans while the other crawls beneath. One makes me lick my lips while the other has me scared. I'd only get in the water with one - even if I was dared!

programmes.t: IFISH: Ballarat, VIC & Nomatu Is. FIJI
programmes.d: From VIC to Fiji in just 30 minutes.
"There's an old saying that every pound of jewfish you catch, you need to spend at least one hour fishing for them." This is true in most cases... unless you're fishing with Wayne "Mulloway" Annetts!

programmes.t: IFISH: ATA Lodge, Alagnak River, Alaska - Part 1
programmes.d: Have you ever dreamed of fishing somewhere so fish rich, that the thousands of fish create one big black mass? Well. come along to ATA Lodge in the remote Alaskan wilderness and get ready for... The Black Hole!
